hero.name: Ivan
hero.description: Software developer specialized in backend applications, APIs, and microservices architectures, primarily using TypeScript, NestJS, and Node.js.

about.description:
I am a software developer and have been living in Chile for the past 8 years. My journey into technology began with studies in video game development, where I acquired my first programming foundations. During the pandemic, I decided to turn that interest into a profession and began learning independently through online courses and personal projects, continuously expanding my knowledge until I landed my first professional opportunity as a developer.
Since then, I have worked on projects for Sbpay, Cencosud, and Walmart Chile, contributing to backend and full stack development, system integrations, and service-based architectures. I currently work primarily with TypeScript, NestJS, Node.js, Java, Spring Boot, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, and Docker. I am looking to continue growing as a developer, take on increasingly complex technical challenges, and contribute to teams where I can keep learning and building high-quality solutions.
